authority: Human priority instruction 2026-10-25; operational resolutions D5 and D6 before ratings/text join
tier: RETROSPECTIVE IN TEXT; T1 PROSPECTIVE IN IMAGE VARIABLE ONLY

primary.strata: folio x registered wrap short/normal; no inferred wrap
primary.eligibility: per folio >=30 readable noninitial slots on EACH side; positive common-stratum exposure; >=8 informative folios
primary.weights: sum_bin nA*nB/(nA+nB), normalized across eligible folios; maximum <=0.25
primary.zeros: Any nonpositive weighted event sum => NOT ESTIMABLE; no smoothing
primary.shuffle: whole line labels unrestricted within folio, including across length bins
primary.selection: Recompute eligibility and weights for EVERY permutation. Any undefined/support-failing draw blocks p; never delete, redraw or condition on passing draws.

scan.statistic: Aggregate event-minus-expected 6-vector and hypergeometric covariance across folio x bin; d transpose pinv(V) d; quadratic upper-tail permutation
scan.support: Operational conservative extension: >=8 informative folios; trace-covariance weights <=0.25; no information => NOT ESTIMABLE
scan.multiplicity: Holm 17 per reading; missing p occupies family position but cannot pass

equivalence.pairs: all 15 unordered pairs of six declared labels, including absent pairs
equivalence.statistic: pairwise MH log rate ratios with same 30-slot/8-folio/25%-weight gates
equivalence.bootstrap: 10000 full folio draws with replacement; each sampled copy is its own stratum/weight unit
equivalence.interval: Simultaneous max-absolute centered deviation q95 (higher order statistic); each theta +/- q95; maximum absolute bound <=0.25
equivalence.missing: Any unsupported pair or undefined draw => unresolved; never skip a pair/draw
equivalence.classification: sensitive iff Holm p<.05 in BOTH; invariant iff no Holm pass in EITHER and simultaneous equivalence succeeds in BOTH; otherwise unresolved

seeds.required_derivation: For production derive per reading/class from SHA256(base:reading:class) first 8 bytes big endian; never tune seeds

outstanding_D4: full-population G6 receipt (G2 separately for PL-only route)
wrap flag owner and exact metadata hashes
